title: Anode-specific lithium recovery: composition to treatment

steps.title: Accept a feed-composition table
steps.question: What is being measured in Table 1?
steps.look: Gate accepts chemical analysis of the anode active material, reported in mg/g.
steps.boundary: Feed composition is not recovery efficiency.

where.table_id: TABLE_Leaching Lithium from the Anode Electrode Materials of Spent Lithium-Ion Batteries by Hydrochloric Acid (Hcl)_0001

steps.title: Identify the anode leaching treatment
steps.question: Does this experiment study the cathode?
steps.look: Process discovery records hydrochloric-acid leaching of calcined powder. The paper identifies that feed as anode material.
steps.boundary: Keep the prepared anode feed distinct from the whole battery and from cathode-focused studies.

where.name: reductive hydrochloric acid leaching of calcined powder

steps.title: Locate lithium in the anode feed
steps.question: Where does 30.07 mg/g come from?
steps.look: The Li column in the chemical-analysis table reports 30.07 mg/g. The emitted relation retains the raw cell and coordinates.
steps.boundary: This is concentration in the input material, not the amount recovered by the process.

steps.title: Keep the adjacent copper measurement separate
steps.question: Can nearby table values be assigned to the wrong metal?
steps.look: The next column reports Cu at 2.87 mg/g. Its column and material anchor differ from the Li cell.
steps.boundary: Cell coordinates and headers establish the assignment; numerical similarity is not a matching rule.

steps.title: Attach the existing Process method scope
steps.question: What does scope add here?
steps.look: The archived method family annotates the leaching Process after document extraction and merge.
steps.boundary: This archive has a Process scope; it does not justify inventing a missing battery-population scope.

where.scope_subject_text: reductive hydrochloric acid leaching of calcined powder

steps.title: Inspect the result without peroxide
steps.question: What does the control report?
steps.look: The reviewed observation reports 97.1% Li leaching on the HCl route without H2O2, distinct from both pure-water and reductive leaching.
steps.boundary: This is an observation for the prepared anode feed, not a general battery recovery guarantee.

where.evidence_span: the leaching efficiency of Li was 97.1% without H2O2

steps.title: Inspect the peroxide-containing result
steps.question: How is 99.4% distinguished from the control?
steps.look: The archive records 99.4% Li leaching for the HCl:H2O2 10:1 condition. The source quotation and conditions identify this observation.
steps.boundary: The archive also has a wt% summary version. Do not silently pool different unit labels or duplicate summaries.

where.evidence_span: it reached to 99.4% with HCl - H2O2 ration being 10:1

steps.title: Trace lithium recovery back to the anode study
steps.question: Can composition and treatment evidence be inspected together?
steps.look: Open the Process neighborhood, inspect Li observations, and navigate back to the source text or the feed-composition table.
steps.boundary: A broad battery input link does not erase the more specific anode context.
